invariants.rationale: The method is documented to always return a TiledMap instance for a valid file, so null is unexpected unless an error is thrown.
A fileName parameter is typically required to resolve and load a map.
A non-empty string is expected for the fileName used to locate the map file.
The result is always expected to be an instance of TiledMap as per the method signature.
The fileName is expected to not consist entirely of whitespace, as it is used for file resolution.
